# Sk Kutubuddin

> Sk Kutubuddin is a freelance web developer and Python programmer from Durgapur, West Bengal, India. He builds responsive websites (restaurant and e-commerce sites), Python automation tools and an AI voice assistant. He is a third-year Computer Science & Technology diploma student at Bengal Institute of Polytechnic (2024-2027) and is open to freelance projects and software internships.

## Main pages
- [Portfolio](https://codewithkutub.online/): projects, skills, journey and contact details
- [Resume (PDF)](https://codewithkutub.online/Kutub_Resume.pdf): full resume

## Projects
- [MAISON Store](https://sweetkutub-svg.github.io/maison-store_E-Commarce/): luxury fashion e-commerce site with cart, wishlist and size guide (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [Mondol Restaurant](https://sweetkutub-svg.github.io/MondolRestaurant/): restaurant website with menu filtering and table reservation (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [Rao's Restaurant](https://sweetkutub-svg.github.io/Rao-s-Resturent/): premium dining site with animations and full menu (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- [Imli Mix](https://sweetkutub-svg.github.io/Imli_mix/): responsive web application, first web project (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- Nova: Python voice assistant with speech recognition, Flask backend and LLM conversation engine with memory ([GitHub](https://github.com/sweetkutub-svg))

## Skills
Python, Java, C, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Flask, MySQL, Git, GitHub, responsive design, data structures, algorithms, OOP, DBMS
